description: Spacious and generous. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: unclear with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: L-shaped sofa in the left of the living zone facing into the room; dining table with six chairs in the upper right near the windows. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor, 14 m² — large enough for bunk beds. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor, desk visible. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 1 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously / bunk bed setup in the larger room — two children sharing, other bedroom freed as dedicated office or hobby space. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households; families wanting two children sharing one large bedroom (bunk beds), keeping the other bedroom as a dedicated office or hobby space. Not suitable for: households needing an en-suite master bedroom; users requiring multiple bathrooms (only one bathroom for three bedrooms); people wanting generous walk-in wardrobes despite the layout note.
